summary: 25-year-old Fort Collins man reported overdue from a Keyhole Route climb on Longs Peak; left Fort Collins ~2 a.m. Monday; rangers located his body ~1,000 ft below the Keyhole Route down the Trough; recovered by helicopter June 12 and transferred to the Boulder County Coroner's Office
location: Longs Peak, Keyhole Route / The Trough
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: Report/location date 2014-06-10 (notified overdue June 10); departed Fort Collins ~2 a.m. June 9; cause not stated in NPS morning report (parent-verified on romo.htm this run).
